newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq seeks to delist EuroMed.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq seeks to delist EuroMed.

text.p: EuroMed Inc said on Tuesday the Nasdaq Stock Market Inc was seeking to delist the company's shares but the company had appealed the determination.
The company also said its independent public accountants, KPMG Accountants NV, had resigned, but indicated they had no disagreements with EuroMed's accounting practices.
The company was not immediately available to comment on why Nasdaq was determined to delist EuroMed's shares.
Nasdaq declined to comment on the reason for a possible delisting.
EuroMed said its appeal would be heard on December 5, and a delisting would be stayed pending the outcome of the hearing.
Robert Shuey III, Chief Executive Officer, said: "We are addressing Nasdaq's concern, and hope that we can prevail upon Nasdaq not to delist this company."

EuroMed Inc is a Nevada corporation with principal executive offices located in the Netherlands. It is engaged in the import and wholesale distribution of branded and generic pharmaceuticals within the Netherlands and the export of generic pharmaceuticals worldwide.
